name.description: Implementation decision: count Unicode code points, preserve exact text, reject Java String.isBlank and ISO controls. NBSP, figure space, narrow NBSP and FEFF are not Java whitespace.

description.description: Implementation decision: required, non-null, up to 4000 Unicode code points; empty allowed, U+0000 forbidden. Runtime encrypts description at rest.

created_at.description: Implementation decision: server-generated UTC RFC3339, year 0001..9999, valid calendar and clock, at most six fractional digits.
